verdict.rationale: Docs confirm each DGX B200 node has 8×B200 GPUs totaling 1,440 GB GPU memory (i.e., 180 GB per GPU), which comfortably fits a 70B-class quantized model, and community feedback (comm-1, comm-2) confirms B200 is well-suited and convenient for practical inference workloads. However, the pack never states per-GPU HBM memory bandwidth (only aggregate NVLink switch bandwidth of 14.4 TB/s at the system level), so the 'memory bandwidth' half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit per-GPU HBM3e bandwidth spec, independent benchmark of single-GPU 70B inference throughput.
